title: Aznar and Ayahay partnership
content: Ayahay is proud to announce our partnership with Aznar, a leading player in the logistics industry. This collaboration marks a significant milestone in our journey to revolutionize the booking and transportation experience for our customers.

title: Survey Findings at Pier 1 in Cebu City
content: We recently conducted an extensive survey at Pier 1 in Cebu City to better understand the needs and challenges faced by our customers. The insights gathered from this survey will play a crucial role in shaping our services and improving the overall customer experience.

title: Onboarding Our First Shipping Line Client
content: We are thrilled to announce the successful onboarding of our first shipping line client. This marks a significant milestone for Ayahay and demonstrates the value and efficiency of our booking and logistics platform.
